name: Dishonest Gain
overview: Scripture condemns dishonest gain as detestable to the Lord, emphasizing that false measures and deceitful practices bring ruin rather than true profit. God calls for leaders who fear Him, hate covetousness, and uphold truth, contrasting the fleeting wealth acquired by vanity with the blessings granted to the faithful who labor honestly. The pursuit of rapid riches through unrighteous means leads to judgment, as illustrated by Ezekiel's depiction of corrupt rulers who exploit others for personal gain. Ultimately, righteousness and integrity deliver from death, while dishonesty invites destruction.
